name: submit_license_renewal
description: submit_license_renewal: Submit a renewal for an existing software license. The license must be within 30 days of expiration or have expired no more than 14 days ago. If outside this window, returns not_in_renewal_window with the expiration date so the caller can be advised to submit a new license request instead.

employee_id.description: The employee renewing the license (e.g. EMP048271).

license_assignment_id.description: The identifier for the specific license assignment being renewed, in the format LASGN followed by a dash and 6 digits (e.g. LASGN-048271).
